meta.title: Enable async stream handlers
meta.body_summary: Make interpreter emit logic non-blocking by using runtime/stream Subscriber to concurrently process stream events from handlers.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI Codex replaced sequential handler loop with async Subscriber pattern; merged immediately without review or performance evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 57 changed lines in a single file, this is a very small edit. It fits a small-step, low-risk performance improvement and was merged within 40 seconds with no review.

review_details.concern_detail: No review feedback or comments recorded; PR was merged by the author without external inspection.
review_details.performance_claim: Async stream handlers prevent one slow handler from blocking the entire emit loop, improving concurrency and responsiveness.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Refactoring interpreter emit to use runtime/stream Subscriber for concurrent handler execution was within agent capability; the small, self-contained change required no benchmark or deep stack knowledge.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after performance data, benchmark, or profiler output; only a narrative claim of non-blocking behavior in the PR body.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regressions or review issues were raised; PR merged without follow-up fixes.

core_change_summary.description: In interpreter/interpreter.go, replaced the sequential loop over `i.handlers` with a subscriber-based pattern: for each handler, a goroutine reads from the stream via `Subscriber` and executes the handler body concurrently; cleanup of subscribers and streams is added to the interpreter's finish logic.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Single file modification; no other files changed.
change_trajectory: Single commit: refactor emit to use stream.Subscriber, add concurrent handler execution, and include cleanup.

collaboration_trajectory: PR created and immediately self-merged by the same maintainer (tamnd) within 40 seconds; no external review or comments.
